meta.title: About — Leroy Joseph, CMEQ Master Electrician
meta.description: Meet Électricité Vision Quantique and its founder Leroy Joseph, CMEQ-certified Master Electrician. Safety, precision and transparency serving Greater Montreal.

about.title: A clear vision of electrical work done right
about.intro: Électricité Vision Quantique is where the expertise of a certified Master Electrician meets a simple conviction: every electrical installation deserves absolute precision.
about.ownerBio1: Founder of Électricité Vision Quantique, Leroy Joseph is a Master Electrician and member of the Corporation des Maîtres Électriciens du Québec (CMEQ). This certification — mandatory to operate as an electrical contractor in Quebec — attests to rigorous training, deep knowledge of the Construction Code and an ongoing commitment to safety.
about.ownerBio2: From replacing a residential panel to connecting three-phase industrial equipment, Leroy approaches every project with the same standard: precise, clean, compliant and durable work.
about.missionText: To provide homeowners and businesses across Greater Montreal with impeccably reliable electrical installations, delivered with transparency and professionalism.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: The safety of people and buildings comes first. No compromises, ever.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: As our name suggests: a quantum vision of the trade — every detail matters, every connection is verified.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Clear quotes, fair prices and honest communication from start to finish.

about.cmeqText: Working with a CMEQ member means the guarantee of a licensed, insured contractor governed by the corporation that has regulated the electrician trade in Quebec since 1950.
about.ctaSubtitle: Entrust your project to a Master Electrician who takes safety seriously.
